summary: Aggressive fast-Castle civ. Ayyubids reach Castle with the Industry wing, build many production buildings at once, and push with camel lancers, camel archers and Dervish healing.
openings: Culture Wing (Logistics, Dervish) into Feudal at about 2:15, with 6 on food and 4 on gold and a tower on gold.
Economic Wing (Industry) into Castle: extra wood and stone and faster building, then 2 to 3 stables and 3 archery ranges at once.

spikes.label: Industry Castle burst
spikes.detail: Right after Castle they mass camel lancers and camel archers, healed by Dervishes. In a pro example the lancers were on the enemy gold at minute 9 to 10.
spikes.answer: You can't stop the fast Castle outright. Get ahead in Feudal with spear and archer and deny their gold, so they must make ghulams and archers instead of free lancers.

spikes.label: Fire mangonel timing
spikes.detail: About seven mangonels with fire upgrades follow as the siege push.
spikes.answer: Take fights only when you can actually kill units; healing turns even trades into wins for them.

scout: Heavy berries and sheep, a back gold with a tower and Culture Wing Dervishes all mean a fast Castle
Front gold means Feudal units to protect it

pairings.why: The Castle timing army, kept alive by Dervish healing.
Siege timing after the camel burst.

winConditions.detail: A Castle-timing attack where healing wins even fights.

howToBeat: Burn their gold tower or counter-tower it.
Win Feudal with spear and archer, then go knight, spear and archer in Castle.
Against Feudal healing, fight only when you can kill units.
